name: pull-deck
description: Chromium extension: your open GitHub pull requests, opened into one tab group without duplicates.

scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run mac:test
scripts.check: node tools/check.mjs && eslint src test tools macos/tools && prettier --check src test tools macos/tools/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs package.json manifest.json .github
scripts.format: prettier --write src test tools macos/tools/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs package.json manifest.json .github
